import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static List<Long> a = new ArrayList<>();
    
    static long fn(long n, long l) {
        long num = n / a.get((int)l);
        n %= a.get((int)l);
        if (n == 0) {
            return num * l;
        }
        return num * l + Math.min(l + fn(a.get((int)l) - n, l - 1), fn(n, l - 1));
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        long t = 1, n, m = 0;
        
        while (a.size() < 17) {
            a.add(m);
            m = m * 10 + 1;
        }
        
        while (t-- > 0) {
            n = sc.nextLong();
            System.out.println(fn(n, 16));
        }
    }
}
